items.source: Enter a new scope with a new root context object and a new local variable scope.
items.translation: 输入一个新的作用域，包含一个新的根上下文对象和一个新的局部变量作用域。

items.source: In contrast to setVariable(String, Object), this method should only be invoked to support assignment within an expression.
items.translation: 与setVariable(String, Object)相反，此方法仅应在表达式内支持赋值时调用。

items.source: In contrast to assignVariable(String, Supplier), this method should only be invoked programmatically.
items.translation: 与assignVariable(String, Supplier)相反，此方法应仅通过编程方式调用。

items.source:
It also acts as a place to define common utility routines that the various AST
nodes might need.
items.translation: 它也是一个定义各种 AST 节点可能需要的一些公共实用程序的位置。

items.source: The active context object is what unqualified references to properties/etc are resolved against.
items.translation: 活动上下文对象是解析未限定属性引用等的依据。

items.source: Look up a named global variable in the evaluation context.
items.translation: 在评估上下文中查找命名全局变量。

items.source: a TypedValue containing the value of the variable, or TypedValue.NULL if the variable does not exist
items.translation: 包含该变量值的 TypedValue，或者如果该变量不存在则为 TypedValue.NULL

items.source: a TypedValue wrapping the assigned value
items.translation: 一个包装了赋值值的TypedValue。

items.source: Assign the value created by the specified Supplier to a named variable within the evaluation context.
items.translation: 将指定的 Supplier 创建的值分配给评估上下文中的命名变量。

items.source: Set a named variable in the evaluation context to a specified value.
items.translation: 在评估上下文中将命名变量设置为指定值。

items.source: name - the name of the variable to assign
valueSupplier - the supplier of the value to be assigned to the variable
items.translation: valueSupplier - 要分配给该变量的值的提供者

items.source: name - the name of the variable to set
value - the value to be placed in the variable
name - the name of the variable to look up
Andy Clement, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
